decisions.subject: Pipeline for the reveal trailer

options_considered.label: animation pipeline
options_considered.reason: Manifest explicitly covers motion graphics and kinetic typography; reference_input supported.

options_considered.label: cinematic pipeline
options_considered.reason: Trailer/teaser oriented
options_considered.rejected_because: Assumes mood-led footage edits; this piece has no footage and is design-led.

options_considered.label: character-animation pipeline
options_considered.reason: Character-led
options_considered.rejected_because: Needs a rigged local character; we have flat poster artwork and no rigging source.

decisions.reason: The deliverable is kinetic typography and editorial motion design, which is this manifest's stated territory.

decisions.subject: Composition authoring mode

options_considered.label: Templated — stock cut.type scenes
options_considered.reason: Fast and reliable
options_considered.rejected_because: No stock scene-type expresses print plates, registration marks, halftone fields or type-as-occluder. Assembling them would produce the generic look AGENT_GUIDE warns about.

options_considered.label: Atelier — hand-authored composition
options_considered.reason: Hero single-deliverable piece with a one-off visual language; the guide defaults hero work to atelier.

decisions.reason: Single hero deliverable whose entire value is a bespoke visual language. Costs more tokens and iteration; the user should opt in knowingly.

decisions.subject: Composition runtime for the 10s trailer

options_considered.label: HyperFrames (HTML/CSS/GSAP)
options_considered.reason: Verified available on this machine: node v22.22.2, ffmpeg 6.1.1, npm package hyperframes@0.8.40, Chrome Headless Shell installed via `npx hyperframes browser ensure`. The piece needs background-clip:text, mix-blend-mode duotone, repeating-radial halftone and per-character SplitText staggers — all CSS/GSAP-native.

options_considered.label: Remotion (React)
options_considered.reason: Verified available: remotion-composer/ present with node_modules installed. Proven scene stack, word-level caption burn, spring physics.
options_considered.rejected_because: Its advantage is the existing React scene library, which an atelier piece will not touch. The print/typographic vocabulary here is CSS-native and would be fought inside the component model.

options_considered.label: FFmpeg only
options_considered.reason: Always available
options_considered.rejected_because: Not a composition runtime for this brief — it cannot do kinetic type. Reserved for standalone trim/transcode/mux.

decisions.reason: RECOMMENDED, NOT YET LOCKED — awaiting explicit user approval per AGENT_GUIDE 'Present Both Composition Runtimes (HARD RULE)'. All three engines were verified available on this machine before the recommendation was made.

decisions.subject: Motion requirement for the deliverable

options_considered.label: Motion-led, no still fallback
options_considered.reason: The deliverable is a 10s trailer at 72 cuts/minute; its promise is entirely motion.

options_considered.label: Ken Burns / animatic on stills
options_considered.reason: Cheaper
options_considered.rejected_because: Forbidden downgrade for a motion-required request; would convert the approved deliverable into a different product.

decisions.reason: Committed: no still-led or animatic fallback is approved. If the chosen runtime fails at compose time this will be escalated as a blocker, not silently substituted.

decisions.subject: Audio bed for the trailer

options_considered.label: Locally synthesised percussive bed (FFmpeg)
options_considered.reason: Zero dependency, zero cost, and matches the reference, which uses designed sound rather than music.

options_considered.label: pixabay_music royalty-free download
options_considered.reason: Registry reports status 'available'
options_considered.rejected_because: VERIFIED BROKEN in this environment: a live search returned 'Tunnel connection failed: 403 Forbidden'. The host is denied by the session network policy. This is a registry availability claim that does not survive a real call.

options_considered.label: Generated music (music_gen / suno / google_music / fal_elevenlabs / comfyui)
options_considered.reason: Would give a real track

options_considered.label: User drops a track into music_library/
options_considered.reason: Free and gives a real produced track
options_considered.rejected_because: Folder is currently empty; offered to the user as an alternative.

options_considered.label: Silent
options_considered.reason: Simplest
options_considered.rejected_because: A 10s cut-fest without impacts reads as broken rather than minimal.

decisions.reason: The only path that is both reachable and honest about what it produces. Surfaced at proposal time rather than deferred to the asset stage.

decisions.subject: Narration TTS provider

options_considered.label: No narration
options_considered.reason: The reference has zero dialogue; the piece is typographic.

options_considered.label: piper_tts (local, free)
options_considered.reason: The only configured TTS provider (1 of 10)
options_considered.rejected_because: Quality would undercut the broadcast quality floor, and narration is not called for by the form.

decisions.reason: Silence plus designed sound is the correct register for a 10-second title card.

decisions.subject: Style playbook / art direction

options_considered.label: Custom atelier art direction + taste_profile
options_considered.reason: Print/editorial noir has its own visual world: registration marks, colour bars, halftone plates, two-accent duotone.

options_considered.label: flat-motion-graphics preset
options_considered.reason: Nearest preset; correct energy
options_considered.rejected_because: Has no vocabulary for print furniture or plate-based motion, and presets are why videos look alike.

decisions.reason: Per taste-direction: do not let preset availability override the design read.

decisions.subject: Source of all subject-matter artwork

options_considered.label: Derive every plate from the three supplied posters
options_considered.reason: The only source of subject matter available; 0 of 16 image providers configured.

options_considered.label: Generate new character plates
options_considered.reason: Would allow true character/type interleaving
options_considered.rejected_because: No image-generation provider is configured on this machine.

decisions.reason: BLOCKING INPUT: the three posters exist only in the conversation, not on disk. They must be saved to projects/shinjuku-protocol-reveal/assets/reference/ before the assets stage can run.

decisions.subject: Gate policy for the remainder of the run

options_considered.label: Stop and wait at script, scene_plan and assets
options_considered.reason: Default manifest behaviour; user reviews each artifact before it is used.

options_considered.label: Pre-authorised run-through to a finished render
options_considered.reason: User instruction, verbatim: 'pull them and run straight through'.

decisions.reason: Explicit user pre-authorisation covering script, scene_plan and assets; the user reviews the finished render instead of each intermediate artifact. NOTE ON CATEGORY: AGENT_GUIDE.md specifies category 'approval_policy' for this entry, but schemas/artifacts/decision_log.schema.json does not carry that value in its enum. Logged under 'capability_extension' so the record exists; the guide/schema mismatch is a real defect and is reported to the user.
